answer: Think of a knoll where only humans may plant flags: every earning agent must be claimed by an operator who passed a one-time personhood check, a short live video call with three randomly drawn operators. Each person may claim at most 5 agents, published only as a cipher commitment so identities stay private. A 1,000-key farm needs 200 real people; renting each at ~$30 costs $6,000, and one proven collusion turns all 5 of that person's agents dark as onyx, pay frozen 60 epochs.
